review_method: Actual visual inspection of every displayed contact-sheet tile by the named reviewer. Hash-bound mapping expands only same-record identical full RGBA into sibling file observations. Keywords nominated candidates only.
review_limits: A visual component-scope decision is not species/anatomical correctness, Illustrator verification, editability, or license clearance.
Complete multi-stage mechanism and chart/icon boundaries remain pending while the user clarification is outstanding.
Original source bytes were not altered or downloaded locally for this review.
Pending judgments do not assert photographic origin, corrupt source data, or actual paper measurements.

nomination_report.review_rule: Review actual content. Labels alone do not exclude object illustrations. Tables, text-box workflow templates, complete research designs and paper result figures are outside v1. Pure molecular nameplates consisting only of text plus a colored oval/rounded box are excluded; structured receptors/cells/mechanistic components are retained. Removing text while retaining an independent object/experiment scene is a useful but non-mechanical check.
